title: TheoLeeCJ/SemIf
why_read: A project implementing 'semantic if' conditionals using local open models on consumer hardware, an interesting niche idea for LLM-infused control flow.
analysis: This project seems to implement a 'semantic if' construct, likely letting code branch based on a language model's judgment of a natural-language condition rather than strict boolean logic, running locally on a consumer GPU (a 3090). This is a niche but conceptually interesting idea in the growing space of blending LLM reasoning with traditional program control flow. The description is sparse, so it's unclear how robust or production-ready the implementation is.
